t: What Watershed Management Database Is All About
title: What Watershed Management Database Is All About
description: Watersheds are land draining to one outlet: manage the land, manage the water. New York City protected the Catskills watershed ($1B+) instead of building a $6B filtration plant — nature's infrastructure. Land use decides water quality: forests filter, pavement rushes, farms leak nutrients. The watershed approach manages the whole drainage, because pollution ignores property lines. This database is the complete watershed record: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
definition: Watershed Management Database: a complete reference database of full watershed record records.
key_points: What this database holds: full watershed record records, each with definition, key facts, and a runnable demo program.
